scientific_question: When symbolic source relations stay the same, does transfer contrast follow the angle between their exact response-operator displacements?

task.boundary_drive: u(0,y)=sum_m c_m sin(m pi y), with zero Dirichlet data on the other sides
task.observation_measure: uniform in normalized coordinates xi=x/a and y

prospective_controls.equal_target_mode_energy: For each target, set Var(c_m) proportional to the reciprocal of the exact target response energy of mode m, then normalize the mean variance to one.
prospective_controls.source_P_relation: same screening as target; aspect ratio is changed until exact response distance is 15%
prospective_controls.source_G_relation: same aspect ratio as target; screening is changed until exact response distance matches P

exact_minimum_change_null.aggregate_prediction: P and G tie at every budget and every target regime.
exact_minimum_change_null.band_prediction: P has lower low-band error and G has lower high-band error at every nonterminal budget.

registered_rivals.continuous_response_direction: Aggregate errors remain tied; opposite band winners follow exact response distance; the source contrast weakens monotonically as the response-direction angle and source-source chord shrink.
registered_rivals.categorical_screening_alignment: P has lower error than G in both bands across screening regimes.
registered_rivals.categorical_aspect_alignment: G has lower error than P in both bands across screening regimes.
registered_rivals.global_regime_specificity: Source ordering changes with target screening in a way not explained by exact response distance or direction.
registered_rivals.learner_specificity: Prospectively distinct learner classes show incompatible source orderings.

outcomes.primary: Signed P-versus-G target error contrast in each mode band, reported beside the exact minimum-change null at every frozen budget.
secondary: aggregate deviation from the exact P/G tie
source contrast versus exact source-source chord
distance from target-only and exact linear-reconstruction references

falsifiers_and_gates: Continuous response-direction reuse is refuted if the farther source repeatedly wins within both bands across declared learner classes.
A categorical account is refuted by the preregistered opposite band winners.
The angle trend is not interpretable if target mode energies or the 15% source radii fail their exact controls.
The high-screening regimes create thinner boundary layers; any later learned comparison must demonstrate equal observation fidelity before the screening trend is interpreted.
No architecture-robust claim is permitted from one learner class.

numerical_verification.method: Closed-form modal responses, Gauss-Legendre quadrature, and scalar root solves for the equal-radius sources.

scope_limits: This is a causal instrument for one separable screened elliptic family, not evidence of broad morphology or PDE transfer.
Equal target mode energy is deliberately designed and is not asserted to be a natural boundary spectrum.
The sweep changes the target screening regime; the registered trend therefore needs later triangulation through a second way of rotating response directions.
